label: Lab 02
title: Every brain on the same tasks
question: Can a small model on your own machine do real agent tasks as well as the cloud models?
how: Hand-written rules, small local models and cloud models play the same tasks, set up the same way each time. Before each run we write down what we expect; afterwards we count, and give each result its margin of error and its limits.
status: Results published · plans written in advance stay private
